content: Kemɨ'ane memɨyɨwawe tukita memeutahaxɨani
»Pɨkayɨweni 'iya 'uki meutahanikɨ Yawé teɨterimama memayutixexeɨriwatsie, xɨka 'ipuriteya pɨratsietɨkani yatɨni xɨka xieyameya haxitekieka.
»'Awienuari pɨkayɨweni meutahani Yawé teɨterimama memayutixexeɨriwatsie, meta nuiwarieya pɨkayɨweni, tamamatarieka nuiwariyaritsieke mepɨyɨwekaxɨani.
»Pɨkayɨweni memeutahaxɨani Yawé teɨterimama memayutixexeɨriwatsie 'amunitsixi meta muhawitsixi, meta nixewitɨ wanuiwarima, tamamata nuiwariyari me'uhukakuke.
Kepauka wakwietsie xemayekɨ paa meta haa memɨkaxe'umikɨ, kepauka 'Ekipitu xe'ayekɨneka mana xemayekɨtsie. Matsi Warami meputa'ini Wehuxi nu'aya, Petuxi paitɨ kiekame Metsuputamiya
kwieyaritsie, mɨxekewaiyakɨ.
Peru Yawé xekakaɨyari xenaki'erietɨ Warami pɨkahanu'eni, hikɨ pipataxɨ 'axakemɨxeyurienikekai 'aixɨa pɨta pɨxe'uyuri.
'Ayumieme, 'ena xe'u'uwatɨ kexemɨteheutere, hatsuaku mɨkɨ wahamatɨa xepɨkaheyuxewiriyani meta xepɨkawareparewieka.
»Xepɨkawaxani'erieka 'Erumi xiɨyarimama, mɨkɨ karikɨ xe'iwama mekanihɨkɨtɨni. Meta 'ekipitutari xepɨkawaxani'erieka, wakwiepa xemu'axɨakɨ teewatari wahepaɨ xe'anetɨ.
Mɨkɨ wanuiwari, mepɨyɨwawe memeutahaxɨani Yawé tukita hairieka nuiwariyaritsie miemete.
Kememɨteyuriekakekai 'ateewa metitetɨ
»Kepauka xemayekɨne xeheyukwiyuka yateewa xemetiyaxetsie memɨxe'aye'unie xewatakwinike, kene'akweriwayurieka mɨkati'itiya hepaɨtsita.
Xɨka xewitɨ xehetsɨa mieme tɨkarikɨ 'axatiheinɨtɨ ka'itiyatɨ hayuhɨtɨani, mɨkɨ xematiteitsie pɨkayuhayewani 'ateewa kanitayerɨmɨkɨ,
peru taikai pɨti'ɨwa, tau hakayuneyu punuani xematiteitsie.
»Xematiteitsie 'ehetewakaku xepitiwauni hakewa xemetikwitani.
Yuxexuitɨ xepeixeiyani kɨyexi 'anuyemɨtsɨme 'etsitɨtɨme, mɨkɨkɨ xepɨwati'ineni, muwa xemeukakwitanikɨ, hikɨ yukwita xepanuteukuni.
Karikɨ Yawé xekakaɨyari xemakutei kaniuyeikani xe'ɨwiyatɨ meta mɨxeyetuirienikɨ memɨxe'aye'unie. 'Ayumieme xemakutei pakupatsieka, xɨka mana xemakutei Kakaɨyari tiuxeiya mɨkatinake, pɨxeku'eirieni.
Hipatɨta 'aitsikate
»Xewitɨ xɨka waɨriyarika mɨti'aitɨarie yukutsiyari hetsɨa heyuta'uname, xɨka 'akie henuani yuti'awietake, ti'aitɨwameya hetsɨa pepɨka'iyetɨayani,
matsi keneuhayewa xehamatɨa muyuhayewanikɨ xekiekaritsie hakewa menuani meta hakewa 'aixɨa mɨreyumaika. 'Ekɨta waɨriyarika pepɨkati'aitɨaka.
»Xewitɨtɨma 'uki yatɨni 'uka 'Ixaheri kwieyaritsie kiekame tuminikɨ muyumayɨina pɨkahayuyeitɨwani tumini ma'iwakɨ yukakaɨyari mɨyetuirienikɨ.
»Yawé 'akakaɨyari tukieyata pepɨkahei'ɨweni tumini mɨpaɨ peyɨanetɨ pehe'iwame, meta mɨkɨkɨ pepɨkare'akatuayani kepemutayɨ mawariyari mayanikɨ, mɨkɨ tihutame Yawé 'akakaɨyari katinixani'erieka.
»'A'iwa pepɨkawawirieka tumini rana'iwakamekɨ, 'ikwaitekɨ meta hipatɨ piinitekɨ rana'i'iwakame.

Pɨyɨwe 'ateewa kiekame pemɨtawawirieni hanamakamekɨ, peru pɨkayɨweni 'a'iwa 'ixaheri tewiyari hetsiemieme. Mɨpaɨ xeteyuriekaku Yawé xekakaɨyari 'aixɨa pɨtiyurieka xe'uximayatsika 'iya kwieyari xemɨyetuiriyarienitsie.

»Xɨka tixaɨtɨkɨ yapetiu'ahɨritɨani Yawé 'akakaɨyari hetsiemieme, pepɨkareutewini pemɨraye'atɨanikɨ, xɨka pekaraye'atɨani mɨkɨ yakamatinita'aitɨamɨkɨ pemɨraye'atɨanikɨ, xɨka pekaraye'atɨani, 'axapekatiniyurimɨkɨ.
'Ahetsie pɨkarahɨiwani xɨka tixaɨtɨ pekatiu'ahɨritɨaka.
Peru xɨka 'a'iyarikɨ yemekɨ petiu'ahɨritɨani tixaɨtɨ Yawé xekakaɨyari hetsiemieme, heitseriemekɨ yaketineuyuri kepemutayɨ.
»Xɨka xewitɨ yu'iwa kaxie haraweriyari mayematsie heutahani, pɨyɨwe mitikwani 'ikwaxiyari kemɨreikwaimɨkɨni, peru meitɨni pɨkayɨwe.
»Xɨka xewitɨ yu'iwa tɨrikuya mayema heutahani, pɨyɨweni tɨriku takari mɨwatihunaxɨani yumamakɨ, peru pɨkayɨweni huxakɨ mitixiteni.
